scholarships.title: Pan African University (PAU) Scholarship - African Union Commission

eligibility: Applicants from African countries and the Diaspora
Master's: undergraduate degree from a recognised university with at least a second-class upper division or equivalent, in a relevant field
PhD: master's degree in a relevant field from PAU or any internationally recognised university

Master's candidates for Conference Interpreting and Translation must have excellent knowledge of at least two African Union official languages (Arabic, English, French, Portuguese, Kiswahili, Spanish)
Meet immigration and visa requirements for the host institute
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to applicants from African countries and the African Diaspora who hold a recognised bachelor's degree (master's) or a relevant master's degree (PhD) and meet the published age limits.
benefits: Full scholarship awarded by the African Union Commission (components not itemised on the official announcement)
coverage: The announcement states the African Union Commission will offer full scholarships to successful candidates; it does not itemise the components
requirements: Certified true copies of relevant certificates and transcripts (university and high school)
Passport or national identity card, personal details page
Clear coloured passport size photograph (2cm x 2cm)
Master's: recommendation letter from one former university lecturer
PhD: recommendation letters from two professors
PhD: 3 to 4 page research concept note (tentative title, research questions, objectives, significance)
Names and contact details of three reference university lecturers (mandatory)
Candidates may be required to undergo a written or oral examination after pre-selection
documents: Contact details of three academic referees
application_method: Complete the application online through the PAU submission portal
Submit all supporting documents as specified in the call
existing.selection_notes: Candidates may be required to sit a written or oral examination after pre-selection. Academic competence must be evidenced in the bachelor's-level transcripts.
existing.best_fit: Young African graduate students aged under 25-28 (master's) or under 28-30 (PhD) seeking a continental postgraduate scholarship administered by the African Union.
existing.notes: Applications for the 2026-2027 academic year closed on 15 December 2025. The award is administered by the African Union Commission, which states that PAU has issued 2549 certificates since 2014 involving students from 50 member states.
existing.duration: Master's and PhD programmes at Pan African University institutes; the announcement does not state programme length
existing.application_period: 15 November to 15 December each year, for the following academic year. The 2026-2027 call ran 15 November to 15 December 2025.
